description: The Claud Butler Haste range is built for adventure, combining rugged durability and capable performance to tackle off-road trails and mixed terrain with confidence. Whether you’re honing your skills on bigger trails or simply exploring the outdoors, these bikes deliver a perfect balance of control, comfort, and versatility. Designed around lightweight aluminium frames with modern geometry, the Haste models offer stability and confidence for off-road riding. Featuring lock out forks and disc brakes – the Haste range is packed with value and functionality, perfect for riders seeking an adventure on a budget. The Claud Butler Haste 2.0, the latest iteration in our mountain bike range, delivers an outstanding combination of performance and value. Built around a strong, lightweight aluminium frame, this updated model features 2x8 Shimano Altus gearing with Rapid-fire shifters for quick and precise gear changes, while Shimano’s MT200 hydraulic disc brakes provide dependable stopping power, with excellent modulation, on every ride. The 80mm suspension fork with a lock-out feature adds versatility, making the Haste 2.0 perfect for a wide range of off-road terrain. We re-designed the previous model to feature a slacker head angle, longer top tube, and shorter head tubes, for improved stability and handling, for a more confident ride. The 720mm wide handlebars and 60mm stem enhance off-road control and comfort, giving you the confidence to tackle bigger trails and develop your off-road skills. Equipped with 650B double-wall rims and fast-rolling WTB Ranger tyres, the Haste 2.0 is ready for mixed terrain adventures. Whether you're exploring new off-road trails or looking for a rugged, dependable bike to get around on, the Haste 2.0 offers it all.
